title: The King's Favour
text: A letter arrives sealed in black wax that is still wet. The old King thanks your House for its loyalty in the matter of the tax, and sends a token of his favour: a ring, river-cold, with a drowned crown on it. He writes that he will see you in the Barrows soon.

outcomes.text: It fits every finger it is tried on. Whoever wears it is obeyed a little faster than they should be, and dreams of a throne under water.

options.label: Carry the letter to the bishop.

outcomes.text: The bishop burns it on the altar. The flame is black and smells of the river. He blesses your Seat himself, and the city hears of it.

options.label: Burn it unread, and never speak of it.

outcomes.text: It burns slowly. For a week afterwards your Seat's fires burn black for a moment before they catch.
